# jd2_earth_rotation_erfa_oracle

- `epochs.csv`: two-part UT1 dates and TT - UT1 offsets written from the fixed rules in the
  header of `tests/jd2_earth_rotation_erfa_oracle.rs` by
  `generate_jd2_earth_rotation_erfa_oracle.py --epochs-only`.
- `erfa.csv`: pyerfa 2.0.1.5 (BSD-3-Clause; liberfa 2.0.1) `gmst82` and `c2t06a`, generated
  2026-10-13.
- Pre-registration: commit b10475ee.
